key_changes: Added bulk action bar showing selected orders count with conditional visibility
Integrated checkbox column in table header and rows for order selection
Added 'Select All' toggle in card header and table thead
Implemented selection state management in Alpine.js
Added bulk status change and clear selection button handlers

patterns_discovered.description: Used x-show, @change, :checked directives for reactive UI state tied to selectedOrders array
Conditional visibility card bar that appears only when items are selected, showing count and action buttons
Server-rendered order data ({% for order in orders %}) combined with client-side selection state management
patterns_discovered.code_example: selectedOrders = [{% for order in orders %}'{{ order.id }}'{% if not forloop.last %}, {% endif %}{% endfor %}]

patterns_discovered.description: Toggle all checkbox that uses :checked binding to reflect current selection state bidirectionally

gotchas_discovered.description: Select All checkbox appears in both card header and table thead with identical logic, creating redundancy and potential sync issues
gotchas_discovered.impact: Maintenance burden and potential UX confusion with duplicate controls

gotchas_discovered.description: Select All checked state uses {{ orders|length }} evaluated at template render time, won't update if table is dynamically filtered
gotchas_discovered.impact: Select All checkbox state may become out of sync if pagination or filtering is applied

gotchas_discovered.description: openBulkStatusChangeModal() contains TODO comment and alert placeholder instead of actual modal implementation
gotchas_discovered.impact: Feature is incomplete; bulk status change functionality not yet implemented

gotchas_discovered.description: No visible form submission or CSRF token handling for bulk operations using selected order IDs
gotchas_discovered.impact: Future implementation of bulk operations must account for CSRF protection

approach_outcome.description: Successfully added checkbox selection UI with reactive state management using Alpine.js
completed_requirements: Checkbox column added to order table
Select All / Deselect All functionality working
Bulk action bar conditionally displayed based on selection
incomplete_items: Bulk status change modal not implemented (marked as TODO)
Backend endpoint for bulk operations not created
approach_outcome.estimated_follow_up_work: Implementation of openBulkStatusChangeModal() modal and backend bulk status change endpoint

recommendations.recommendation: Consolidate duplicate Select All checkboxes into single shared control to reduce redundancy
recommendations.rationale: Currently implemented in two locations with identical logic; consider creating a reusable component or single source of truth

recommendations.recommendation: Implement openBulkStatusChangeModal() function and corresponding modal HTML
recommendations.rationale: Currently has placeholder alert; needs proper modal dialog with status selection options

recommendations.recommendation: Add CSRF token handling and server-side validation for bulk operations
recommendations.rationale: Selected order IDs need to be submitted securely with CSRF protection when bulk actions are performed

recommendations.recommendation: Refactor hardcoded order count comparison to use dynamic JavaScript length check
recommendations.rationale: Current :checked binding uses template-evaluated count which won't update with dynamic changes; use this.selectedOrders.length === visibleOrders.length pattern

recommendations.recommendation: Add visual feedback when bulk status change completes successfully
recommendations.rationale: Once modal is implemented, provide toast notification or table refresh to confirm bulk operation success

recommendations.recommendation: Consider pagination-aware bulk selection for large order lists
recommendations.rationale: Current Select All only selects visible orders on current page; clarify if this is intentional or should include all pages
